hints.title: Single Element Edge Case
hints.text: When n == 1, if k is odd the single element is repeatedly removed and the pile becomes empty, returning -1.

hints.title: Zero Moves Edge Case
hints.text: If k == 0, no elements are removed so the topmost element is nums[0].

hints.title: Candidate Pool Selection
hints.text: You can remove k - 1 elements and push the largest back, or remove k elements so nums[k] becomes the new top.

hints.title: Greedy Boundary Maximum

complexity.notes: Scanning the prefix up to k - 1 takes linear time bounded by n.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating game moves with recursion or BFS explores exponential branches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate rigorously enumerates edge cases (n=1, k=0, k=1, k>n, k<n).
